firm_data.firm_description: Yapchanyk, Prezioso & Yang is House Counsel for Chubb, providing cost-effective, quality legal defense services. The firm represents the interests of Chubb insureds in matters litigated in Federal and New York State courts and administrative agencies.
notable_facts: Accredited Continuing Legal Education provider in the State of New York
Licensed by the New York and Connecticut Insurance Departments to teach continuing education courses for brokers

email.subject: AI for Yapchanyk, Prezioso & Yang - built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Christopher,

Your firm's AV rating and track record defending professional liability and errors and omissions cases for Chubb insureds shows the caliber of work you're delivering. We work with similar practices that balance high-stakes litigation with lean teams.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms facing BigLaw demands with smaller headcount. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in NYC to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to show how we're helping practices like yours compete and win.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
